sql:
SELECT
  T1.title,
  T1.url
FROM fct_posting AS T1
WHERE
  T1.platform = 'reddit'
  AND T1.family = 'ai_engineer'
  AND T1.is_open = TRUE
  AND T1.remote_us = TRUE
